name: Django Drf
summary: Django REST Framework patterns. Trigger: When implementing generic DRF APIs (ViewSets, serializers, routers, permissions, filtersets). For Prowler API specifics (RLS/RBAC/Providers), also use prowler-api.

name: React 19
summary: React 19 patterns with React Compiler. Trigger: When writing React 19 components/hooks in .tsx (React Compiler rules, hook patterns, refs as props). If using Next.js App Router/Server Actions, also use nextjs-16.

name: Tailwind 4
summary: Tailwind CSS 4 patterns and best practices. Trigger: When styling with Tailwind (className, variants, cn()), especially when dynamic styling or CSS variables are involved (no var() in className).

name: Zod 4
summary: Zod 4 schema validation patterns. Trigger: When creating or updating Zod v4 schemas for validation/parsing (forms, request payloads, adapters), including v3 -> v4 migration patterns.

name: Zustand 5
summary: Zustand 5 state management patterns. Trigger: When implementing client-side state with Zustand (stores, selectors, persist middleware, slices).
